sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Arun Mishra,Vijay Pratap Singh Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Ashwani Kumar Mishra,J.
Hon'ble Donadi Ramesh,J.
Complaint has been instituted against the petitioner under the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, which is pending before the Additional District Magistrate (City), Prayagraj.
Petitioner submits that reply to this notice has been submitted, but the authorities are keeping the matter pending without taking any decision in the matter.
This petition, therefore, has been filed with the prayer to drop Complaint No. D2024020300 of 2024, under Section 26/52 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

sentences.text: Learned Standing Counsel submits that in the event proceedings have not been concluded, the concerned authority shall accord consideration to the petitioner's reply and shall proceed further, in accordance with law.

In that view of the matter, we dispose of this petition with a direction upon respondent no. 1 to accord consideration to the petitioner's reply and conclude the proceedings, expeditiously and in accordance with law.
In order to facilitate such consideration, we permit the petitioner to annex all materials including his reply, while submitting certified copy of this order before respondent no.1.
